description: Find every real anagram of your word — all unique permutations checked against a built-in word list.

faqs.a: Up to 8 letters (8! = 40,320 permutations max), all checked in your browser instantly.
faqs.q: How long can the word be?

faqs.a: A built-in list of common English words filters the permutations down to real words.
faqs.q: How does it find real words?

faqs.a: The count shows real anagrams found out of total unique permutations checked.

howto: Type a word up to 8 letters.
title: Anagram Generator
